verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a hardware security key, since such products can ship management CLIs or SDKs. The evidence shows Titan has no API of its own: setup, removal, reset and unpairing are all documented as manual UI or physical steps. The runtime probe states Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface, and fleet management lives in a separate product (the Workspace Admin console). FIDO CTAP protocol support is an authentication standard, not a management API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
